HOW WE BUILD

Process

Every GameFactory game ships through a three-stage process.

01STEP 01 · Design

Blueprint

We lock in one core fun, then detail the rules and balance down to blueprint level. Nothing vague ever hits the line.

02STEP 02 · Assembly

Rapid Build

We assemble fast, moving between AI build tools and hand-written code. Build small, run it right away, fix it right away.

03STEP 03 · Inspection

Playtest

We play it ourselves, find the parts that aren't fun, and send them back down the line. Only games that pass inspection ship.
